name: z_emep_ew
scheme_description: Full NLO EW in MG5_aMC's loop_qcd_qed_sm (alpha(M_Z) scheme: aEWM1, MZ and MW all inputs; lhv=1, epsUV=epsIR=1) at its default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM), real on-shell masses with all widths zero, stable top, Feynman gauge. MadLoop only: the Recola and OpenLoops drivers have no translation of these inputs.
scope: Independent provider references at exact on-shell decimal points; MadLoop in quadruple precision at every point (return codes 328); timings are single-run by-products, not benchmarks.
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); F_MadLoop=F_Recola+pi^2/6*D; OpenLoops truepoles=1, polenorm=0; physical couplings, no alpha extraction; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included

fortran_flags.source: MG5_aMC run-card defaults global_flag/aloha_flag/matrix_flag (CommonRunCmd.update_make_opts of an optimised MG5 run); MadLoop's own makefile adds -O3 for polynomial.f

mg5_quadruple_precision_model_function_r: added KIND=16 to 19 CMPLX calls in MP_ functions
settings.quadruple_precision_stage: every point: the run's loop_matrix.f copy bypasses MadLoop's double-precision acceptance, so its quadruple-precision stage (MLStabThres test over two propagator directions; Ninja, else CutTools) evaluates every point (references.force_quadruple_stage)
